From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: QBR prep: pipeline triangulation + account micro-summaries

Team —

Closing the loop for QBR prep. We need a tight, defensible narrative for next week: consolidated forecast, account-level confidence, and a short one-pager per top opportunity. Please read below and send back account-level bullets in the format I show (ARR / Q4 commit / confidence / blockers / next step).

Requested deliverables (by EOD today):
- Consolidated forecast table (by ARR bucket: <50k, 50-250k, 250k+) — reference attached CSV.
- Top 10 accounts: 3-line micro-summary (ARR, close target, confidence score and primary risk).
- Any legal/procurement blockers flagged (procurement contact + expected dates).
- Two-slide exec-ready summary (one slide: top risks/opps; second slide: runway / forecast delta).

Attachments: 20261118-QBR-pipeline-export.csv, mutual_action_plan-template.docx, acme-account-onepager.pdf

Notes: prioritize strategic accounts (Acme, BlueCloud, NovaRetail). If you need a direct intro to the buyer/procurement, say so. I want an internal one-line executive note at top for each account: e.g. "ACME — $420k, Q4 at risk (procurement review)".

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Notes below — pulled key data from HubSpot and last-touch sales notes. Short and actionable.

1) Acme Corp — $420,000 ARR
- Q4 commit: $350k (discount workstream w/ procurement)
- Confidence: 55% (procurement review + security signoff pending)
- Primary blockers: SOC2 evidence, custom SLA wording, procurement cadence (expect response 11/22)
- Next step: Procurement will share redlines; I will schedule contract review with legal on 11/23. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2345

2) BlueCloud Systems — $180,000 ARR
- Q4 commit: $180k (on target; PO pending)
- Confidence: 80%
- Primary blockers: billing contact confirmation, minor API integration checklist
- Next step: Marissa to lock billing contact; expect PO by 11/24

3) NovaRetail — $95,000 ARR
- Q4 commit: $60k (pilot extension suspected)
- Confidence: 40%
- Primary blockers: pilot success metrics not yet validated; client asked for two-week POC extension
- Next step: Provide POC success criteria document by 11/19; I will own the follow-up

If helpful, I can convert these into the two-slide exec view you asked for — propose: slide 1 = top 6 accounts + delta vs. plan; slide 2 = three high-risk remediation actions.

-Markus
